step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts SBB Cargo's digital twin telemetry processing pipeline for freight train inspection. Data from sensors on locomotives/tracks (Producer) is sent to an initial ingestion Lambda function that transforms raw input formats into a Kinesis Data Stream. Kinesis Analytics filters out millions of daily unneeded samples to retain only critical state data, routing it to a central normalized Kinesis Data Stream. A bottom Lambda function processes records from this normalized stream and writes them into DynamoDB, forming the digital twin state. On the query side, downstream algorithms (Consumer) request train condition data through API Gateway, which delegates to the bottom Lambda function to read state from DynamoDB and return the result.

nodes.name: PRODUCER
nodes.notes: Train sensors (locomotives, tracks) producing telemetry/sensor data (~3M samples/day per locomotive).

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Top)
nodes.notes: Ingests raw telemetry data in various formats and forwards it to Kinesis.

nodes.name: KINESIS (Top)
nodes.notes: Ingestion Kinesis Data Stream holding raw sensor telemetry.

nodes.name: KINESIS ANALYTICS
nodes.notes: Filters raw data stream to retain only critical telemetry required for train inspection.

nodes.name: KINESIS (Middle)
nodes.notes: Centralized, normalized Kinesis Stream receiving harmonized data from ingestion pipelines.

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Bottom)
nodes.notes: Handles persistence of normalized telemetry into DynamoDB and executes API retrieval queries.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Stores digital twin state and normalized sensor records.

nodes.name: API GW
nodes.notes: Exposes HTTP endpoints for analytical algorithms and downstream clients.

nodes.name: CONSUMER
nodes.notes: External client or algorithm assessing overall train condition and safety.

edges.notes: Producer sends raw sensor telemetry in any format to the ingestion Lambda.
Ingestion Lambda forwards raw data into the top Kinesis Data Stream.
Raw Kinesis Data Stream feeds records into Kinesis Analytics for filtering.
Kinesis Analytics forwards filtered, high-value data to the middle normalized Kinesis Stream.
Normalized Kinesis Stream triggers the bottom processing Lambda function.
Bottom Lambda formats and persists digital twin telemetry into DynamoDB.
Bottom Lambda queries digital twin data from DynamoDB upon request.
Bottom Lambda returns requested telemetry to API Gateway.
API Gateway returns requested train data back to consumer algorithm.
